description: MITRE ATT&CK as a pack over the core ontology: techniques, tactics and mitigations, and the evidence that a technique was used.

concepts.name: Technique
concepts.description: An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique: a way an adversary achieves a goal, such as T1003.001 LSASS Memory.

concepts.name: Tactic
concepts.description: An ATT&CK tactic: the goal a technique serves, such as Credential Access.

concepts.name: Mitigation
concepts.description: An ATT&CK mitigation: a way to stop a technique from working.

relationships.name: indicates
relationships.description: Something seen in the data matches a rule for the technique. It is a lead, not proof the technique was used.

relationships.name: uses
relationships.description: ATT&CK records that a group or a piece of software uses a technique or another piece of software.

relationships.name: mitigates
relationships.description: The mitigation works against the technique.

relationships.name: subtechnique_of
relationships.description: The sub-technique is a narrower form of the technique.
